chunks: Aḥmad ibn Mihrān, from ʿAbd al-ʿAẓīm ibn ʿAbdillāh al-Ḥasanī, from Mūsā ibn Muḥammad, from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, from one whom he mentioned, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, concerning His, the Exalted's, saying:
And that if they had remained steadfast upon the path, We would surely have given them abundant water to drink.

He عليه السلام said: It means, if they had remained steadfast upon the wilayah of ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib, Amīr al-Muʾminīn, and the awṣiyāʾ from among his descendants عليهم السلام, and accepted obedience to them in their commands and their prohibitions, We would surely have given them abundant water to drink—meaning: We would have made their hearts drink faith. And the path is faith in the wilayah of ʿAlī and the awṣiyāʾ.

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام as Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.الطَّرِيقَةِ: the path, interpreted here as the way of true faith and steadfastness
key_terms.الْأَوْصِيَاءِ: the successors appointed after Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.الْإِيمَانَ: faith placed firmly into the hearts
key_terms.طَاعَتَهُمْ: obedience to their commands and prohibitions
key_terms.مَاءً غَدَقًا: abundant water, interpreted here as an abundance of faith

ai.seo_question: What does Qur'an 72:16 mean in Shia tafsir regarding the path and abundant water?
ai.summary: This narration explains the verse as referring to steadfastness upon the wilayah of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام and the awṣiyāʾ from his descendants عليهم السلام. The promise of abundant water is interpreted as Allah filling their hearts with iman, making the 'path' a reference to belief in their divinely ordained authority.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Mihran, from Abdul Azeem Bin Abdullah Al Hasany, from Musa Bin Muhammad, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub, from the one who mentioned it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> regarding the Words of the Exalted
[72:16] And that if they should keep to the (right) way, We would certainly give them to drink of abundant water.

Heasws said: ‘It Means if they (people) were to be steadfast upon the Wilayah of Aliasws Bin Abu Talib Amir Al-Momineenasws, and the successorsasws from hisasws sonsasws, and accept to be in theirasws obdeince regarding theirasws orders and their prohibitions, We would certainly give them to drink of abundant water, Heazwj is Saying: “Weazwj would Make their hearts to drink the Eman”, and the doctrine, it is the belief in the Wilayah of Aliasws and the successorsasws’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ahmad ibn Mahran has narrated from ‘Abd al-‘Azim ibn ‘Abdallah al-Hassani from Musa ibn Muhammad from Yunus ibn Ya‘qub from the person whom he mentioned, from abu Ja‘far (a.s.). The Imam (a.s.) said the following about the words of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High.
“Had they (jinn and mankind) remained steadfast in their path (religion, Islam), We would certainly have given them abundant water to drink.” [72:16]

It means, “Had people maintained steadfastness in respecting the Divine authority of Amir al-Mu’minin Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.), and the Divine authority of his successors from his children and agreed to obey their orders and prohibitions He would have given them abundant water. He says, We would drench their hearts with faith. The path (al-Triqa) means to have faith in the Divine authority of Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) and his successors from his children.”
